_notes: Single model family available today (per 2026-09-17 design conversation): claude-sonnet-5, via the real Claude Code CLI (v2.1.146+, confirmed on hal5000 at C:\Users\wsoll\.local\bin\claude.exe -- NOT the restricted /opt/cowork/claude-bin/claude found on the Cowork device-bridge sandbox's own PATH, which only supports bare `claude -p "<prompt>"`).
Originally scoped around a private 'fable' model; superseded -- model identity now lives here, not hardcoded in review_cli.py, so it can be repointed without touching code.

'effort' is a reasoning-effort/tier label, not a distinct model family -- it is how lane/budget-tier stakes get expressed with only one model available (see design conversation: 09/10 keep the strongest tier regardless of budget; probe-budget lanes run cheaper/faster). Maps directly to claude's own --effort low|medium|high|xhigh|max.

Quorum panels (design-v3.md Sec5) additionally use 'personas' (see quorum_personas below) since real model-family diversity isn't available yet -- every quorum result must still be tagged diversity_requirement_met:false downstream. Personas are implemented as claude --agents/--agent (real named agents, not just swapped system-prompt text), see quorum_personas.agent_definitions.
max_budget_usd values below are PLACEHOLDERS ($ figures not yet confirmed with the repo owner) -- do not treat as final; see open question in the accompanying chat turn.

budget_max_usd_per_call._note: PLACEHOLDER figures -- confirm real dollar caps before run/run-all goes live. These are per single `claude -p` invocation, not per lane or per run; a pooled lane with N workers spends up to N times this per lane.

quorum_personas._note: Used only for lanes running an evidence-qualified quorum panel (currently 09). 2 personas for WARRANTED-tier votes, 3 for malfeasance/NO-GO/RE-DAST-escalation tier, per design-v3.md Sec5.1.

skeptical-refuter.description: Tries to disprove the claim under review using only cited evidence.
skeptical-refuter.prompt: You are an independent verifier whose job is to try to REFUTE the claim you are given. Do not assume it is true. Look for missing prerequisites, alternate explanations, and evidence gaps. State your verdict as WARRANTED, NOT-WARRANTED, or UNRESOLVED, with the specific evidence you checked.

neutral-evidence-auditor.description: Independently re-derives the finding from cited evidence only, without reading the discoverer's prose.
neutral-evidence-auditor.prompt: You are an independent verifier. Work only from the cited artifact spans and evidence locations given to you -- not from any discoverer's narrative description of what they concluded. Independently determine the mechanism, prerequisites, and consequence, then state WARRANTED, NOT-WARRANTED, or UNRESOLVED.

aggressive-hypothesis.description: Assumes the claim is real and tries to strengthen it with further evidence, as a stress-test counterweight to the refuter.
aggressive-hypothesis.prompt: You are an independent verifier taking the opposite stance from a refuter panelist: assume the claim may be understated. Look for cited evidence that would make the mechanism, prerequisites, or consequence MORE severe than described, while still requiring every conclusion to be evidence-backed. State WARRANTED, NOT-WARRANTED, or UNRESOLVED.

invocation.status: CONFIRMED 2026-09-17 against claude 2.1.146 on hal5000 (real user install, not the sandbox-restricted binary). Flags below are all real flags from `claude -p --help`'s actual output, not assumed.

per_call_flags.prompt: positional argument, the filled handoff prompt text (or read via stdin -- TBD, see open question)
per_call_flags.add_dir: --add-dir {scoped_paths} -- for pooled lanes (07/08/03/04), scope each worker to ONLY its assigned parallel_review_group's paths plus the run's inputs/outputs dirs, not the whole target repo. Real filesystem-level scoping, not just a prompt instruction.
per_call_flags.allowed_tools: --allowedTools {lane_tool_allowlist} -- per-lane, e.g. most lanes: Read,Grep,Glob,Write (Write restricted to this lane's own outputs dir via --add-dir); 02-evidence-pregather needs Bash; 11-remediation-proposal needs Edit for patch proposals. Not yet enumerated per lane -- next slice.
per_call_flags.permission_mode: --permission-mode bypassPermissions -- PROPOSED, not yet confirmed with repo owner: since nobody is present to answer an interactive permission prompt in an unattended run, and --allowedTools/--add-dir already provide the real scope boundary, permission-mode bypass is proposed as the mechanism rather than relying on interactive approval that would just hang. Open question -- see chat.

invocation.agent_flag: --agent {persona_name} --agents {quorum_personas.agent_definitions as JSON} -- used only for quorum panel calls (currently lane 09), one call per panelist.
open_questions: Prompt delivery: positional arg vs. stdin vs. a prompt file flag -- handoff prompts can be long (subprompts.md content, artifact manifest); need to confirm claude -p's practical limit for a positional-argument prompt before deciding.
Real dollar caps for budget_max_usd_per_call -- currently placeholders, not confirmed.
permission-mode choice (bypassPermissions vs. a narrower mode) -- proposed, not confirmed.
Whether claude -p inside a WSL/bash invocation vs. a PowerShell invocation changes any of the above -- confirmed so far only from a PowerShell shell on hal5000.
